name: humanizer
use_label: Make AI drafts read like a person
one_liner: Strips the tells of AI-generated writing out of a draft.

text.why: A draft written by a model reads smoothly but keeps its own verbal habits, and readers spot them first. humanizer is an agent skill that finds and removes those traces at the draft stage, attached to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. It is written in Python under the MIT license and has its own skill distribution page. What counts as an AI tell varies by genre, so read the result yourself.
text.take: A rule set that names 25 AI writing tells and removes them; a sensible first pass before a human edit.
build: An in-house polishing step every draft passes before publishing
A post-processing rule that pulls drafts back to the brand voice

who.situation: strips AI tells from a model-written draft
matches the prose to their own voice before publishing
keeps reference prose plain and neutral
